title: Yellow Smoky Middle Eastern Nectarine Baba Ganoush
description: A smoky and comforting Middle Eastern dish featuring nectarines, served as a baba ganoush with a glassy-jelly texture, perfect for a snack or dessert. This low-carb friendly recipe is best served with ssam-wrap on a slate tile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the nectarines in half and remove the pits.
Place the nectarines on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 30 minutes.
Remove the nectarines from the oven and let them cool.
Scoop the flesh of the nectarines into a blender or food processor.
Add the smoked paprika, lemon juice, garlic, tahini, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to the blender.
Blend the mixture until smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the baba ganoush on a slate tile with ssam-wrap on the side.
